title: Human replies label values and empty states; JSON and write receipts remain complete.
verification: Routine replies use concise command-specific projections and pages. JSON envelopes and write replies remain complete. Only oversized registered human reads refuse atomically above 28,000 UTF-8 bytes; the refusal names the field, filter, limit and paging flags that command really has, or --full for complete human detail. List reads use --limit/--offset paging and explicitly name the next page when cut short.
